name: Custom LINK titles and two bugfixes
body:
## What's Changed
* chore: bump github/codeql-action from 4.38.3 to 4.39.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/pull/3250
* feat(LINK): add a custom link title argument by @stanislaw in https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/pull/3252
* chore: bump uv from 0.12.5 to 0.13.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/pull/3257
* fix(export/html): read pasted text before handling images by @cristianchiriac in https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/pull/3256
* fix(traceability_matrix): skip included documents when listing nodes by @cristianchiriac in https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/pull/3255
* release: bump version to 0.30.4 by @stanislaw in https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/pull/3260


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/strictdoc-project/strictdoc/compare/0.30.3...0.30.4
